name: op75_compact_subset_equivalence
lines: hclosed : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 1, F x ∈ Icc 0 1
hbool : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 1, F x ≠ 1 → E x = 0 ∨ E x = 1
hpre0 : ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 1, ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, F x = y ∧ E x = 0
hpre1 : ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 1, ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, F x = y ∧ E x = 1
⊢ (∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E as x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E as x).2 = t) ↔ op75_subset as t
⊢ (∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E [] x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E [] x).2 = t) ↔ op75_subset [] t
⊢ (∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E [] x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E [] x).2 = t) → op75_subset [] t
⊢ op75_subset [] t → ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E [] x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E [] x).2 = t
⊢ ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E [] x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E [] x).2 = t
⊢ ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E [] x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E [] x).2 = 0
ih : ∀ (t : ℝ), (∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E as x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E as x).2 = t) ↔ op75_subset as t
⊢ (∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).2 = t) ↔ op75_subset (a :: as) t
⊢ (∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).2 = t) → op75_subset (a :: as) t
⊢ op75_subset (a :: as) t → ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).2 = t
hs : (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).2 = t
htail : op75_subset as (op75_run F E as (F x)).2
⊢ op75_subset as (op75_run F E as (F x)).2
⊢ ∃ x_1 ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E as x_1).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E as x_1).2 = (op75_run F E as (F x)).2
hsum : a * E x + (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t
⊢ a * E x + (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t
hsum : a * 0 + (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t
this : (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t
hsum : a * 1 + (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t
this : (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t - a
⊢ (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t - a
⊢ ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).1 = 0 ∧ (op75_run F E (a :: as) x).2 = t
hys : (op75_run F E as y).2 = t
hys : (op75_run F E as y).2 = t - a
⊢ a + (op75_run F E as y).2 = t
⊢ ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, op75_compact_map x = y ∧ op75_compact_digit x = 0
⊢ ∃ x ∈ Icc 0 1, op75_compact_map x = y ∧ op75_compact_digit x = 1

steps.tactic:
induction as with
| nil => rfl
| cons a as ih => simpa [op75_run, h1] using ih

induction as generalizing t with
| nil =>
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, he, hs⟩
    simpa [op75_run, op75_subset] using hs.symm
  · intro ht
    have ht' : t = 0 := by simpa [op75_subset] using ht
    subst t
    exact ⟨0, by norm_num, r …
have ht' : t = 0 := by simpa [op75_subset] using ht

have hne : F x ≠ 1 := by
  intro heq
  have hzero : (op75_run F E as 1).1 = 0 := by simpa [op75_run, heq] using he
  rw [op75_run_one F E h1 as] at hzero
  norm_num at hzero
have hzero : (op75_run F E as 1).1 = 0 := by simpa [op75_run, heq] using he
rw [op75_run_one F E h1 as] at hzero

have htail : op75_subset as (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 :=
  by
  apply (ih _).mp
  exact ⟨F x, hclosed x hx, by simpa [op75_run] using he, rfl⟩
exact ⟨F x, hclosed x hx, by simpa [op75_run] using he, rfl⟩
have hsum : a * E x + (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t := by simpa [op75_run] using hs
rcases hbool x hx hne with hE | hE
have : (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t := by linarith
have : (op75_run F E as (F x)).2 = t - a := by linarith
obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0, hys⟩ := (ih t).mpr ht
obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx, he0⟩ := hpre0 y hy
obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0, hys⟩ := (ih (t - a)).mpr ht
obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx, he1⟩ := hpre1 y hy
have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * x := by linarith

have hb : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |4 * x - 3| := by
  have h := neg_le_abs (4 * x - 3)
  linarith
have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.1]
have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2]
have hxb : 4 * x - 3 ≤ 0 := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2]
have hsel : op75_compact_digit x = 0 := op75_compact_digit_low x (by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2])

have hfx : op75_compact_map x = y := by
  unfold op75_compact_map
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hxb]
  have hsmall : 4 * x ≤ -(4 * x - 3) := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2]
  rw [min_eq_left hsmall, min_eq_right (by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2])]
  dsimp …
have hsmall : 4 * x ≤ -(4 * x - 3) := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2]
have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.1]
have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2]
have hxb : 0 ≤ 4 * x - 3 := by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.1]
have hsel : op75_compact_digit x = 1 := op75_compact_digit_high x (by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.1])

have hfx : op75_compact_map x = y := by
  unfold op75_compact_map
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hxb]
  have hsmall : 4 * x - 3 ≤ 4 * x := by linarith
  rw [min_eq_right hsmall, min_eq_right (by dsimp [x]; linarith [hy.2])]
  dsimp [x]
  ring
have hsmall : 4 * x - 3 ≤ 4 * x := by linarith

exact
  op75_subset_orbit op75_compact_map op75_compact_digit op75_compact_closed op75_compact_one op75_compact_boolean
    op75_compact_pre0 op75_compact_pre1 as t
